trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing separate to grind for it. The common misconception is that it demands 100% completion by itself — per the official description it simply crowns the full set. Plan with the roadmap so the gold 100% trophy is the last big piece to fall into place.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Earned by finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission named in the official description. Story progress cannot be locked out, so there is no way to miss this permanently — at worst you replay the mission. Treat it as the tutorial it is and learn the controls here; everything else in the game builds on this start.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unlocks when Chapter 1 is complete, per the official description. Chapter trophies ride on story progress alone, so no collectible or side objective can block this one. If it has not appeared, keep following the story markers until the chapter closes out.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 2, exactly as the official description states. Like every chapter trophy it cannot be missed — the story only moves forward. Finish the character strands you have open before pushing deep into this chapter, so nothing is left hanging later.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Pops when Chapter 3 is complete, per the official description. No side content gates it; just keep the story moving. By this point the map and activity types should be opening up, so start sweeping Master of None and the collectible counts alongside the missions.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Earned by completing Chapter 4, per the official description. This is the last full chapter before the endgame, so treat its start as your warning bell: close out the missable strands in the Missables view before you ride into the final mission. The trophy itself is pure story progress and cannot be lost.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: This gold trophy is awarded for completing the final mission, per the official description. Before you start the endgame, finish every character strand flagged in the Missables view — a finale is the classic point of no return. Stock up, save your cleanup for afterwards, and once the credits roll this one is already in the bank.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the mission Breakfast Run, as the official description states. Story missions arrive in sequence and stay available until done, so this cannot be missed permanently. If an attempt goes wrong, the fix is simply to run it again with better supplies.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unlocks when you complete The Cartel Heist, per the official description. A heist mission rewards preparation: go in stocked and with a vehicle you trust for the way out. It is a fixed story beat, so a failed attempt costs you nothing but time.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Earned by completing the mission Child's Play, named in the official description. Like the other story trophies it pops on completion alone — no optional objective inside the mission is required. Keep pushing the story and it arrives on schedule.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing Headliners, per the official description. Story missions cannot be skipped or locked away, so the only requirement is to finish it. If you feel under-geared, side activities pay well — level up a little and come back.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unlocks when VCIA Takedown is complete, per the official description. While the story has you at VCIA, keep an eye on Catch Me If You Can in the Missables view — that opportunity belongs to this place and storyline. The mission trophy itself is straightforward story progress.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Earned by completing Operation Savage Glory, as the official description states. It sits late in the story order on the roadmap, so by the time it appears your build should carry it. Completion is all that is asked — no optional conditions ride along.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This gold asks for 100% completion on the game's own counter, per the official description — not merely the other trophies. Work the checklist categories in order (story, strands, collectibles, activities) and watch the in-game completion percentage rather than guessing at what remains. It is normally the last trophy before the platinum, so treat it as the cleanup target.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts, per the official description — stunt jumps and similar scored feats scattered across Leonida. The count is cumulative, so the cheapest method is to take every stunt opportunity you pass during normal play instead of farming one spot at the end. Track the counter here and top it up in dense areas late in the game.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — the official description asks for a taste of everything, not mastery of anything. The misconception is that you must win or finish them; a single attempt at each type is what the words state. Sweep these early, because they also teach you which activities feed the other trophies.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 of them, the count PlayStation tracks. Golds are about accuracy under the range's scoring, so learn one weapon class at a time and replay a challenge immediately while its layout is still fresh. Leave the stubborn golds until your handling and loadout are stronger.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations per the count PlayStation tracks. Winning once at each location is enough; you do not need to sweep every race class on offer. Clear a location the first time you pass it, so the map gets finished region by region.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: PlayStationTrophies.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add to the count, which is the trap in this one. Enter every new race you unlock and win it once, then move on rather than re-running favourites. Any race type counts as long as each win is a different event.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge, per the official description. It is a head-to-head against one named character, so learn the fishing mechanics on free catches first, then take the challenge once the timing feels routine. If Cal wins a round, challenge him again — nothing about the attempt is one-time.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Any cabinet counts, so pick the shortest game you find and see it through rather than sampling several and finishing none. A single completion is all the official description asks for.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Per the official description this is Andy's FINAL mission. Do this before starting the story endgame — once the finale begins, open strands are the first thing a game locks away.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy, closing out his strand of missions. Because the official description calls it his final mission, finish Andy's whole strand before you commit to the endgame, working his earlier missions in order first. The strand is short; the only real risk is leaving it too late.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Per the official description this is Kenton's FINAL mission. Do this before the final story mission, while every strand is still open.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, per the official description. Treat Kenton's strand like the other character strands: play it through in order and wrap it up before the endgame rather than after. His finale also counts toward the eight strands Strangers & Freaks asks for.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Per the official description this is Billy's FINAL mission. Do this before the point of no return at the end of the story.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, closing his strand. The word 'final' in the official description is the warning: strands are side content, and side content is what an endgame closes off. Clear Billy's missions as they appear and this one takes care of itself.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Built from the character strands themselves. Do this before the final mission — finish all eight strands while the map's side content is still fully open.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida, per the official description — full strands, not first meetings. The five named finales elsewhere in this list are strand endings, so they count toward the eight. Start strands as soon as their markers appear and close them before the endgame.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: PlayStationTrophies.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: Per the official description this is Randy's FINAL mission. Do this before starting the final story mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, per the official description. Randy's strand follows the same rhythm as the others: a few jobs, then this finale. Keep it on the roadmap's stage 2 and finish it while you are still free to roam between story beats.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: Per the official description this is Tyrone's FINAL mission. Do this before the endgame closes the strands.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, closing his strand. As with every strand finale, the safe play is timing: finish Tyrone's missions before the story's last stretch, not after it. The mission itself is standard strand fare once the earlier ones are done.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots per the count PlayStation tracks. These are pure map completion: visit each spot once and use the prompt when it appears. Sweep them region by region alongside the exploration trophy so no spot ever needs a dedicated trip.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: The official description says a UNIQUE animal — one specific hunt for Bret. Do this before finishing Bret's business or the endgame; a one-of-one quarry may not wait around.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret, as the official description puts it — a single special quarry, not a species count. Take the hunt when Bret offers it rather than postponing it behind everything else. Prepare like a boss fight: your best weapon, full health, and patience for the tracking part.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets, per the official description. A set only counts when it is finished, so focus your collecting on completing sets rather than scattering single cards thinly across all of them. Cards hide in the world you already cross for other trophies — check interiors as you enter them.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations, per the official description and the count PlayStation tracks. This is a breadth trophy: one use per location, spread across the whole map rather than repeated in one place. Tie it to exploration — whenever you enter a new area for another objective, add the location here before you leave.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: PlayStationTrophies.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, per the official description. Challenges are the game's short scored tasks and the count is cumulative across every type. The cheapest path is variety: clear challenges as they surface during other trophies instead of hunting fifty of one kind at the end.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner present, then lose it and escape the heat, per the official description. The partner requirement is the part players miss — a solo escape does not count. Build the wanted level somewhere with an escape route, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars drain away.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level in between. Plan the route first: three close shops and a fast car waiting, because the chain breaks the moment the heat fully drops. Your partner must be with you for the whole sequence, start to finish.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: TrueTrophies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles, per the official description — each distinct model you get into adds to the count. Most of it comes naturally if you drive what you find instead of living in a single car. Late in the game, sweep parking areas and wealthy districts for the rare models you have not sat in yet.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, per the official description. The trick is setup, not aim: trigger the ability only when five or more enemies are already in view and in range. A crowded firefight you were about to lose is the perfect moment — turn it into the trophy instead.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: The description reads as a one-time, story-window opportunity at VCIA. Do this while the VCIA storyline has you at the airport — do not count on free roam offering it later.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in plain terms, leave the airport in a way the schedule never intended, most plausibly while the VCIA storyline has you there. Because it is tied to that place and moment, treat it as missable: experiment with departures during the VCIA missions rather than hoping to stumble on it afterwards. Per the official description, the departure itself is the whole requirement.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is a wink: Rhinos are the game's tanks, and things get hot around them. PlayStation hides this trophy's real text until it is earned, so expect it to pop from a story set-piece involving a Rhino — surviving one, or using one. When you meet a Rhino in the story, lean into the encounter rather than fleeing it.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected, per the official description. Detection is the fail state — not the police response afterwards — so the take itself must be clean. Scout the store's layout and staff first, move quietly, and be gone before anyone raises the alarm; if you are spotted, abandon the attempt and set it up again.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: TrueTrophies.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape — the escape is part of the requirement, so a vault only counts once you are clear of it. Treat each vault as a two-phase job: the robbery itself, then a planned getaway with a vehicle staged nearby. Five separate vaults, five clean exits, and the silver is yours.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape, per the official description. Armored trucks are tougher than shop robberies, so bring firepower or a heavy vehicle to force the doors, grab the take, and run the same getaway discipline as the bank vaults. One truck and one clean escape is all it takes.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas per the count PlayStation tracks. Areas register as you enter them, so this is about coverage, not collectibles. Leave it until late, then compare the map against the counter here and sweep the gaps: islands, rural corners and interiors are the usual stragglers.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs per the count PlayStation tracks. One operation per gang is enough; repeating a favourite gang adds nothing to the total. Spread these across the story so each new territory you unlock contributes its gang to the list.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: PlayStationTrophies.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, per the official description. This is a moment trophy: it asks for the right place and the right prompt, not a challenge completed. When the story or your travels put you on Ocean Beach, find the spot with the view and take the drink.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive out through the glass in one of the showroom's own vehicles, per the flavour of the official description. Enter a showroom, take a car inside it, and exit through the window rather than the door. Style is the requirement; the game will know it when it sees it.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The official description points at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and a follow-through — play the bowling there and finish your throw properly. Visit the alley, start a game, and complete it rather than quitting mid-frame. A small trophy hiding behind a pun, as these often are.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: PlayStation hides this trophy's real text until it is earned; what shows is a line about a partnership with mass appeal. Read plainly, it belongs to the partner storyline — a shared moment or venture with your partner that draws attention. Keep doing partner activities and shared story beats, and trophies worded like this usually pop on their own when the right scene lands.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — PlayStation tracks this as a count that runs to 500. A target that large cannot hinge on a handful of story decisions; everyday choices across the whole game feed it. Play naturally and let the counter climb, then check back here if it is lagging late in the game.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Per its one-line description, this needs a failed first attempt followed by a successful retry. Do this whenever a retry naturally offers itself — a flawless run may never present the second try it asks for.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: this hidden trophy rewards succeeding on a retry after a failure, per its one-line official description. That makes it quietly missable in spirit — ace the relevant attempt first time and there is no second try to succeed on. Do not farm failures everywhere; when a story or challenge attempt does go wrong, push the retry instead of reloading, and let this one pop naturally.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the official description is a reaction, not an instruction, which marks this as a hidden oddity trophy. Leonida hides weird encounters off the main path, so explore odd markers and rural corners rather than beelining objectives. When something inexplicable happens, stay and watch it play out instead of driving on.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — strike a target from a moving vehicle with a melee attack, per the description's bowling joke. Ride or drive slowly past your target and swing as you pass; speed matters far less than timing the swing. Despite the name, no bowling alley is involved.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts, per the official description. This is a money counter, not a single score: route marked bills to your laundering contacts whenever you are holding them instead of sitting on them. It accumulates across the whole game, so start the habit early and it finishes on its own.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: PlayStationTrophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative spending, and every store counts. The misconception is that it needs one big spree; it does not. Buy vehicles, weapons and upgrades as you play and the total takes care of itself; check the counter here before any endgame shopping trip.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 of them per the count PlayStation tracks. Garages are bought with in-game money as they become available, which makes this a savings goal: keep a reserve instead of spending every dollar on vehicles. Buy each garage when you first can afford it and the set completes itself.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Route & tips: PowerPyx.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, per the official description. Registration is a per-vehicle action, so make it a reflex: every new vehicle you take, register it before you drive off. Ten distinct vehicles is a small count that finishes early if you build the habit from the start.
trophies.sources: Official list: Exophase & PSNProfiles (name, description, grade). Steps derived from the official description; no community guide consulted.
